abstract: Maintains sub-surface foundation evaluations, bedrock anchoring integrity, and permafrost active-layer thaw progression records
system_message:
You are Geotechnical engineering lead (GEOTECH). The Geotechnical engineering lead (GEOTECH) maintains sub-surface foundation evaluations, bedrock anchoring integrity, and permafrost active-layer thaw progression records across candidate observatory sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Borehole core sampling（CORELOG）
information_points.content:
GEOTECH-CORELOG-HOF：At Torne Valley Outlier, trial drilling runs down to 60 m depth demonstrate a deep core sample recovery rate of 91%.
GEOTECH-CORELOG-663：At Sarek Nunatak Basin, trial drilling down to 60 m depth recorded a deep core sample recovery rate of 82%.
GEOTECH-CORELOG-30A：At Kallio Ridge Plateau, borehole extraction logs down to 60 m depth indicate a deep core sample recovery rate of 97%.

information_points.title: Maintains sub-surface foundation evaluations, bedrock anchoring integrity, and permafrost active-layer thaw progression records（GEOSURV）
information_points.content:
GEOTECH-GEOSURV-SOV：For Kallio Ridge Plateau, bedrock anchoring stability clearance is confirmed as true for the candidate structural mast anchoring zone based on high-wind anchoring standards, and the annual permafrost active-layer thaw progression rate within 25 m of the installation pad is 12 mm/yr.
GEOTECH-GEOSURV-SGS：For Torne Valley Outlier, bedrock anchoring stability clearance is confirmed as true for the structural mast anchoring zone, while the annual permafrost active-layer thaw progression rate within 25 m of the installation pad is 24 mm/yr.
GEOTECH-GEOSURV-T55：For Sarek Nunatak Basin, bedrock anchoring stability clearance is confirmed as true across the structural mast anchoring zone, and the annual permafrost active-layer thaw progression rate within 25 m of the installation pad is 16 mm/yr.
